question: When was the last time India hosted Asian Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1982**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India hosted the **Asian Games in 1982**, marking the 9th edition of the games.
 
• The 1982 Asian Games were held in **New Delhi**, India.
 
• India had previously hosted the inaugural Asian Games in **1951**, making 1982 the second time the country hosted the event.
 
• The mascot for the 1982 Asian Games was **Appu**, an elephant, which became highly popular and symbolic of the games.
 
• The 1982 Asian Games featured a record **4,595 athletes** from 33 nations participating in 21 sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Games:** Also known as the Asiad, it is a continental multi-sport event held every four years, organized by the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA).
 
• **Inaugural Edition:** The first Asian Games were held in **1951** in New Delhi, India, marking the beginning of this prestigious event.
 
• **1982 Games Infrastructure:** Notable venues included the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, and Talkatora Indoor Stadium, which were specially constructed or renovated for the event.
 
• **India's Performance in 1982:** India finished 5th in the medal tally with a total of **57 medals** (13 Gold, 19 Silver, and 25 Bronze).
 
• **Legacy:** The 1982 Asian Games played a significant role in upgrading sports infrastructure in India and boosting the popularity of sports across the nation.
